cases.name: Helen McKinney Hoover
cases.about: "She's very, very kind, warm, wanting to help type person. Everyone you talk to says that she was so kind and she was so nice," her daughter Angela Hoover-Brasher said. "And we ask, you know, why that would happen to someone like her. She loved her family, she wanted to be with us as much as possible."
